title: Genetic and Phenotypic Effects of Chromosome Segments Introgressed From Gossypium barbadense into Gossypium hirsutum
author: Weiwu Song

steps_raw.instruction: Gently crumble about 2 leaf tissue by the freezing grinding machine (MM400) in a microfuge tube.
Add 700 μl of CTAB buffer which had been preheated in 65 ℃ water bath.
Incubate the CTAB/plant extract mixture for about 45 min 65 ℃ in a recirculating water bath.
Add equal volume of chloroform/iso-amyl alcohol (24:1), Mix for about 3min. Spin the mixture at 12000 g for 15 min to spin down cell debris.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase only (contains the DNA) to a clean microfuge tube.
Precipitate DNA with 500 μl of cold isopropanol.

Following precipitation, the DNA can be pipetted off by slowly rotating/spinning a tip in the cold solution. To wash the DNA, transfer the precipitate into a microfuge tube containing 500 μl of ice cold 70 % ethanol and slowly invert the tube. Repeat.
Resuspend the DNA in sterile DNase free water.
Mix the following in 96-well plates for PCR applications:Water（6.2µl），Template（1.2µl），F-Primer（0.5µl），R-Primer（0.5µl），dNTP（0.5µl），10xPCRbuffer（1µl），TaqDNApolymerase（0.1µl）
Put the 96-well plates in PCR machine with heated lid.
Prepare polyacrylamide gel
Pour the gel mix in plate carefully to avoid bubbles. Insert comb into plate. Leave to polymerise for about 1 hour. Pour 1X TBE into electrophoresis apparatus, remove the comb.
Load 1.2 ul of each sample into individual wells of the gel .
Run gel until the dark blue just runs off the bottom of the gel or as appropriate.
Remove the gel and separate the plates carefully with a single-edged razor blade.
Place the gel in tray with the fixer and leave shaking in a fume hood for 10 minutes. Pour off fixer(400ml H2O+50ml 90%alcohol+30ml 10% acetic acid ).
Wash with water and pour off the water.
Add silver-stain(0.9g AgNO3 +300ml H2O ) and leave shaking for 12 minutes
Wash with water, rinse again and pour off the water.
Immediately agitate the gel in the developer(6g NaOH +7ml methanol +5ml o.2% Na2S2O3 +400ml H2O) until band development progress sufficiently.
Rinse gel in water.
Scan the gel with a computer flatbed scanner, or photograph.
